---
title: "wrapped fixture: metadata values with var()"
filters:
  - wrapped
format: html
wrapped:
  breakpoint: calc(var(--bp))
  width: calc(var(--w) * 0.5)
---

![A wrapped figure.](plot.png){#fig-meta-calc-var .wrap-right}

A media query takes no var(), so the breakpoint stays at its default, with a warning. The width reaches the HTML as written, with its two hyphens, and with no warning.
